g.text: Dragons of Mugloar: frontend sketch (Vue + Pinia)
Numbered red markers refer to the UX notes on the right. IDs refer to REQUIREMENTS.md.
Desktop 1280px: /play (manual play, calls the game API directly)
Escort Ibn Ali to the castle
Desktop 1280px: /autopilot (bot runs on the bot service)
Start is disabled when the run cap is reached (429).
Escort Ibn Ali to the castle
Icon beside the text, all widths.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 5000.
Busy: only the clicked button spins; others queue (WEB-12)
Start a run to watch the bot play.
Stopping... the bot finishes its current
move, then the run ends as 'stopped'.
1 Stats stay visible at all times: lives, gold, level, score,
turn (WEB-03). Both screens add the stored high score,
raised by games and runs (WEB-18). Lives turn red at 1.
2 Quest board: ads keep the game's order. The player can sort
by reward, expiry or risk. No bot pick, no EV by default (FUN-01).
Risk badges are colored and labeled, so color is never the
only signal (NFR-03). Encrypted ads appear decoded, with a tag.
3 Every quest has the same Solve button. Risk shows through the
label and 'At stake: 1 life'. Trap tags only appear with the
4 Shop: items the user can't afford are disabled, with a tooltip
Potion first, because it's the most common purchase.
5 Event log: newest first. Green = success, red = failure or
6 Run form: validated inline (VAL-04). Stop is enabled only
while the selected run is running (WEB-08, BOT-12).
7 Run list: status badges (running / finished / stopped /
failed). Clicking a run opens its live view and history.
8 Score chart: a dashed 1000 target line shows progress toward
9 Live events stream over SSE with a 'live' dot. The log
auto-scrolls unless the user has scrolled up.
10 Mobile: one column, with stats in a 3x2 grid. Shop, reputation and
log open as bottom sheets, with a bottom tab bar for navigation (NFR-01).
11 Choose: Solve sends the API call at once and locks the other Solve
buttons (status: resolving). Shop, Refresh and Investigate stay
enabled and queue (WEB-12). Nothing is chosen for the player.
12 Suspense, in a dialog over the board: the stakes
(win gold / lose a life), the risk label and an animation. Hold the result for a minimum time
even if the API answers first (FUN-02, FUN-03).
13 Climax: the copy changes, the progress bar fills, and tension
14 Reveal, in the same dialog after the suspense phase.
Clearly different success and failure, with the game's message
and deltas. The stats animate. The result stays until the player
presses Continue or Close, then the board is back (FUN-04). Failure on the last
15 Advisor (opt-in): EV and trap tags, but never reorders the
board or marks a best pick (WEB-07). EV = p x reward -
Calculation shown below the advisor sketch.
16 Milestones: 1000 points, new high score, last life (FUN-08).
17 Reputation: people, state and underworld, shown with a sign.
Unknown until the player presses Investigate, which uses one
turn, so it is never automatic. A new game clears it (WEB-16).
- 640-1023px: ad grid with 2 columns; shop, reputation and log below
- >= 1024px: ads in 3 columns + side panel (shop, reputation, log)
- Every action is a real <button>, with a visible focus ring
- Tab order follows the visual order
- The live log is an aria-live='polite' region
- The suspense and reveal play in a modal dialog.
- Contrast is at least 4.5:1 and the risk badges have text
The API call fires the moment the player clicks Solve. A dialog shows it in progress for a minimum time, then reveals the result in the same dialog.
Other quests stay in board order.
Defend the village from a band of trolls
Defend the village from a band of trolls
Result is held, not shown yet.
Min duration by risk: 1.5 s (Piece of cake)
up to 4 s (Suicide mission). Slow API: wait
Last life! A healing potion costs 50g.
Same order as before, no "best" marker.
No suspense phase: 0.6 s float-up + log entry.
Also: "New high score!" when the score
Fast = half the time. Instant = reveal only.
How the Advisor EV is calculated (WEB-07, CORE-06)
EV = p x reward - (1 - p) x lifeCost
p success chance, from the probability
reward gold the ad pays on success
lifeCost gold value of the life lost on failure:
Shown rounded, with a sign. Negative is red.
Each ad is scored on its own; the board is
Same ad, lower EV as lives drop.
Advice only: the EV never reorders the board
and never marks a best pick (FUN-01, WEB-07).
With the toggle off, no EV and no trap tag show.
